changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE support_tickets ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, description TEXT,
raised_by BIGINT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
allow_impersonation BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, impersonation_until TIMESTAMP,
created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
CONSTRAINT fk_support_ticket_user FOREIGN KEY (raised_by) REFERENCES users(id) );

changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE impersonation_session ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
ticket_id BIGINT NOT NULL, admin_id BIGINT NOT NULL, super_admin_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, ended_at TIMESTAMP,
created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
CONSTRAINT fk_impersonation_ticket FOREIGN KEY (ticket_id) REFERENCES support_tickets(id),
CONSTRAINT fk_impersonation_admin FOREIGN KEY (admin_id) REFERENCES users(id),
CONSTRAINT fk_impersonation_super_admin FOREIGN KEY (super_admin_id) REFERENCES users(id) );
